title: pr-codex send preflight result v1
description: Structured verifier pipeline result emitted directly by the /pr-codex:send Step 4.5 Codex verifier via --output-schema / --output-last-message, then cross-field validated by tasks/validate_preflight_result.py. PASS_WITH_WARNINGS is intentionally not a verdict; warnings are represented per violation via severity=warning and never flip the top-level verdict. Strict structured-output compatibility: every field is required and optionality is expressed as nullable types (violation finding_id / comment_index); numeric minimums and the RFC 3339 generated_at format are enforced by the Python validator.

auto_fixable_count.description: Count of violations with severity=error and auto_fixable=true. Non-negativity and recomputation are enforced by the Python validator.

requires_human_count.description: Count of violations with severity=error that require human attention. Non-negativity and recomputation are enforced by the Python validator.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with timezone (e.g. 2026-05-06T00:00:00Z); format is enforced by the Python validator.

note.description: 1-2 sentence human-readable rationale for the stage status. May be an empty string.

rule.description: Stable rule identifier from the violation classification table. Non-emptiness is enforced by the Python validator.

finding_id.description: Related canonical finding id, or null when the violation is not tied to a specific finding.

comment_index.description: Zero-based index into payload.comments[], or null when the violation is not tied to a specific comment. Non-negativity is enforced by the Python validator.

detail.description: Human-readable violation detail. Non-emptiness is enforced by the Python validator.
